messages:
janet: Heads-up — Maple (my office cat) found a moth and has appointed it her new stuffed toy. Photo dump incoming 🐱🦋
photo-bot: janet uploaded 3 files
omar: oh nooo the tiny predator 😭 love the loafing posture in pic 2
mike: maple is single-handedly maintaining insect population control. salary negotiations? :money_mouth_face:
selina: this is peak office morale. sending a virtual catnip treat 🍃 :heart_eyes:
janet: pic 1 is Maple with the moth (gentle), pic 2 is her dramatic nap with it on her nose, pic 3 is the moth now living under her chin like a secret advisor 😂
omar: can confirm dramatic nap = boss energy. also, what kind of moth is that? it looks like a tiny fuzzy scout
selina: it might be a snout moth? i'm no entomologist but fuzzy wings = very dramatic
mike: maplestory update: she refused to share the moth during standup, intercepted my banana bagel instead. 10/10 would be demoted by cat again
janet: quick poll — should i frame the moth nap pic for the kitchen wall or is that too extra? :frame_with_picture: :thinking_face:
omar: frame it. memorialize the hero. :thumbsup:
selina: definitely frame. also add a plaque: "Maple — Chief Moth Officer"
mike: vote: frame + plaque. i will pay $5 toward the frame fund (venmo me @mike)
janet: sold. ordering a tiny frame. will hang next to the ficus. thanks for the moral support and micro-donations :sweat_smile:
omar: citizen science idea: if Maple keeps recruiting moths we should start a very small database of 'Maple sightings' with timestamps :spiral_calendar:
janet: adding to calendar now. thanks team, Maple says hi and wants more catnip. end of thread.
